processingRules.sourceCalibration: Master standing reference sets target height; every source uses one standing reference and one shared scale for every pose
processingRules.alphaCleanup: Keep largest reviewed complete opaque component and alpha within radius2; discard distant alpha; zero fully transparent RGBA
processingRules.transforms: One complete-image uniform scale and translation only; no per-frame size fit; sit/rest/sleep keep source proportions
